title: ADCO Industries – E-Commerce Platform
longDescription: Built a headless e-commerce platform with dynamic CMS and SEO-optimized rendering. Integrated Shopify Storefront APIs for full cart and checkout lifecycle. title: Best Rooms Only (BRO)
longDescription: Built full-stack booking platform with search, filtering, and reservation workflows. Implemented RBAC authentication for admin and user management. Optimized performance and SEO using Next.js architecture.

title: VoiceAgent
description: AI Voice Application with real-time interaction.
longDescription: Developed real-time voice interaction system (speech-to-text → LLM → text-to-speech). Designed asynchronous pipeline for low-latency communication. Improved response accuracy with context-aware processing.
